title: markdown-index document index
description: The document index: every indexed document keyed by its UUID. Documents with no front matter land under the empty key.

document.title: markdown-index document
document.description: One markdown file as indexed. Its identity is its UUID, not its path.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the vault root, always with forward slashes.

modifiedUnix.description: Last modified, as a unix timestamp in seconds.

metadata.description: Front matter parsed from YAML and re-encoded as JSON. Empty when the file has none.

frontmatter_cid.description: CIDv1 (dag-json codec, sha2-256) of the front matter, base32-encoded.

raw_markdown.description: File content with the front matter block stripped out.
